active_task.title: Re-audit search results through selected-tour and lead transitions
required_gates: Fast CI only if a concrete product-code fix is created
targeted visual QA only for user-facing affected route/state
Deploy + Production smoke only if released
evidence: PR #656: completed search renders first 25 hotels and expands to up to 100 on the same searchId.
PR #658: stars, rating and price can narrow the already loaded result set while widening beyond source constraints uses server re-search.

Official Tourvisor search-results schema confirms hotel-level region/subRegion, but meal/operator only exist inside nested tours[] and the contract does not guarantee that nested offers are exhaustive for every hotel; PR #666 therefore keeps meal/operator on server search while retaining proven local filters.
PR #663 invalidates selected-tour and flight async generations and clears stale selected-tour/lead UI on v2:search-reset.

PR #669 fixes confirmed stale selected-tour pricing when switching from a priced flight to a flight whose price is unavailable: stale prior flight price is cleared, tour base/fuel state is restored coherently, and pricePending is emitted without changing lead transport or external contracts.
Fast CI and Security guard passed for PR #669; merge SHA f4bc4517f4e2da6fe375753203e85f0313be58ae.

Post-merge controller audit PASS: selecting a second tour increments tourGeneration and flightGeneration, clears current tour/flight state before rendering, and ignores late tour/flight responses whose generation or tour id no longer matches.
Post-merge search reset audit PASS: v2:search-reset invalidates both async generations, clears currentTour/flightVariants/selectedFlightIndex and hides selected-tour UI.

Post-merge lead retry/idempotency audit PASS at browser boundary: submit is disabled during a request, failed sends re-enable retry with form data preserved, successful sends set dataset.sent and server duplicate responses are handled as deduplicated success.
Post-merge child-age context audit PASS: active search snapshot child ages are validated to 0..17, capped to three entries and keep childs consistent before the existing lead request is sent.
Production evidence remains blocked by the prior external live-probe environment; continue independent product QA.
HIGH-risk areas remain approval-gated by AGENTS.md and project-contract.json.
